periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward towards the muzzle relative to the horizontal axis of the head.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the vertical axis approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch tapers distinctly at its lowest point, creating a teardrop-like extension towards the lower face.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, covering approximately 35% of the total visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, with the gap between ears roughly equivalent to the width of one ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Broadly rounded and smooth curvature at the superior apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan discoloration is present on the fur of the posterior and hindquarter regions compared to the cream-colored midsection.
